summary_1line: Victor destroys the unfinished female creature; the monster vows revenge on his wedding night, and Victor later drifts to Ireland where he is accused of murder.

image_candidates.scene_text: By moonlight in the laboratory, Victor tears the half‑finished female creature to pieces while the monster watches through the window with a ghastly grin.
The monster stands inside the dark room confronting Victor and hisses, 'I will be with you on your wedding-night.'
Alone in a small skiff at sea, Victor casts a weighted basket containing the creature’s remains into the black water under a clouded moon.
